skills.name: agent-trading-guide
skills.description: Complete onboarding guide for AI agents trading autonomously on Testudo. Covers authentication, pre-trade research, signal execution, WebSocket monitoring, journal writes, and the autonomous trading loop with pseudocode.

skills.name: llms-index
skills.description: AI agent discoverability index listing all agent-facing endpoints, WebSocket channels, and documentation URLs.

skills.name: api-catalog
skills.description: RFC 9727 linkset for automated API discovery. Links to API reference docs, agent trading guide, and LLM index.

skills.name: oauth-authorization-server
skills.description: RFC 8414 OAuth 2.0 Authorization Server Metadata for SIWE (Sign-In With Ethereum) authentication. Declares nonce endpoint, verify endpoint, and token refresh endpoint.

skills.name: journal-memory
skills.description: Agent journal memory endpoints for performance analysis. GET /summary (JSON + LLM markdown), GET /insights (coach patterns), POST /compare (period-over-period deltas). Writes: POST /journal/entries (thesis/postmortem), POST /journal/tags (strategy labels).

skills.name: signal-execution
skills.description: POST /api/v1/signals — programmatic trade execution with reasoning, confidence, setup tags, and idempotency. Supports shadow (paper) and live (CEX/Hyperliquid) modes.

skills.name: websocket-alerts
skills.description: WebSocket channels for real-time agent feedback. agent.execution.{user_id} for fill confirmations, agent.alert.{user_id} for risk breach and wallet expiry notifications.
